abstract: Using the agent‐based model SWISSland, we simulate farm‐level responses and interactions under two institutional shocks: tariff reductions and direct payment reductions. Using a framework we developed, we assess resilience capacities, resilience attributes, and the provision of private and public goods, following the shock. Results indicate that valley farms are vulnerable to tariff reductions and mountain farms to direct payment reductions. Payment cuts cause minor changes in private and public goods provision, while tariff reductions reduce provision levels. It shows that different shocks require different resilience attributes, underscoring the need for ex‐ante resilience assessments to develop targeted measures strengthening farm resilience.
abstract_zh: 基于主体模型SWISSland，我们模拟了两种制度冲击下的农场层面响应与互动：关税削减与直接支付削减。运用我们开发的框架，评估冲击后的韧性能力、韧性属性以及私人与公共产品的供给。结果表明，山谷农场易受关税削减影响，而山地农场则对直接支付削减更为敏感。支付削减对私人与公共产品供给的影响较小，而关税削减则降低了供给水平。这表明不同冲击需要不同的韧性属性，凸显了开展事前韧性评估以制定针对性措施、增强农场韧性的必要性。
title: Ex‐Ante Assessment of Farm Resilience to Institutional Shocks: A Modeling Approach
title_zh: 制度冲击下农场韧性的事前评估：一种建模方法

abstract: The article estimates the effect of extreme temperature on labor in the manufacturing and services sectors in the Philippines. We use firm-level survey and temperature data and exploit the exogenous annual variation of maximum temperature. We find a rise in the projected annual increase of extreme temperature from climate change by 0.08℃, reduces employment by 14 workers for a firm with 136 employees in export-focused industries in dry regions. Male, temporary, skilled workers in large, technology-dependent, non-food firms, are most affected by extreme temperature. The mechanism is the reduction in capital investment leading to a complementary reduction in labor hired.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了极端温度对菲律宾制造业和服务业部门劳动力的影响。我们利用企业层面调查数据和温度数据，并借助最高温度的外生年度变化进行分析。研究发现，气候变化导致的极端温度预计年均上升0.08℃，将使干旱地区出口导向型行业中拥有136名员工的企业减少14个就业岗位。大型、技术依赖型、非食品类企业中的男性、临时工、熟练工人受极端温度影响最为显著。其作用机制在于资本投资减少，进而导致雇佣劳动力出现互补性下降。
title: The Effect of Extreme Temperature Shocks on the Type of Firm Labor Hired
title_zh: 极端温度冲击对企业雇佣劳动力类型的影响

abstract: The wildlife valuation literature largely focuses on eliciting willingness-to-pay for wildlife conservation, not recreation, and frequently groups species together under the banner of “wildlife”. This study employs the contingent valuation method to value the likelihood of viewing specific wildlife in Grand Teton National Park (GTNP). We estimate willingness-to-pay (WTP) and willingness-to-accept (WTA) for species-specific recreation trips to explore substitutability between popular wildlife species. Estimates across species better equip wildlife managers to balance the inherent tradeoffs associated with climate impacts on habitats and populations as well as changing interests among recreationists.
abstract_zh: 野生动物价值评估文献主要关注的是为野生动物保护（而非休闲娱乐）而引致的支付意愿，且常将不同物种笼统归为“野生动物”范畴。本研究采用条件价值评估法，对在大提顿国家公园观赏特定野生动物的概率进行价值评估。我们估算了针对特定物种的休闲旅行支付意愿与接受意愿，以探究热门野生动物物种之间的可替代性。跨物种的估算结果能更好地帮助野生动物管理者平衡气候变化对栖息地与种群造成的固有权衡，以及休闲者兴趣变化带来的影响。
title: Species-specific wildlife recreation demand
title_zh: 物种特异性野生动物休闲需求

abstract: Abstract Providing home energy information to home buyers makes efficiency more salient in purchasing. We study the impact of disclosed energy efficiency information on housing prices in Portland, Oregon after the introduction of a Home Energy Score mandate for houses on the market. We find a $1 decrease in annual energy costs is associated with an approximate increase in housing value of $24 to $40. This effect is stronger for houses that are already energy efficient and for larger houses.
abstract_zh: 摘要 向购房者提供家庭能源信息，使能效在购房决策中更加凸显。我们研究了俄勒冈州波特兰市实施房屋上市强制披露家庭能源评分政策后，公开的能效信息对房价的影响。研究发现，年能源成本每降低1美元，住房价值约增加24至40美元。这一效应在已具备能效优势的房屋及面积较大的房屋中更为显著。
title: Mandatory Disclosure of Home Energy Efficiency
title_zh: 强制披露家庭能源效率

abstract: Abstract Rationed access is an important tool to promote sustainable use of public lands. However, online reservation systems can lead to “buying frenzies” when low prices create excess demand. Using transaction-level data for river permits in the United States sold both by reservation-system buying frenzy and lottery, I show successful frenzy buyers reside in wealthier zip codes than those selected at random. This effect increases with congestion and leads to an unequal distribution of consumption benefits where high-income zip codes receive 25 percent more recreational trip value. These effects can undermine park managers’ efforts to provide equitable access through low fees.
abstract_zh: 摘要 配额准入是促进公共土地可持续利用的重要工具。然而，当低价引发超额需求时，在线预订系统可能导致“抢购热潮”。利用美国河流许可证的交易层面数据（这些许可证通过预订系统抢购和抽签两种方式出售），我发现成功抢购者所在的邮政编码区域比随机中签者更为富裕。这种效应随拥挤程度加剧而增强，并导致消费收益分配不均——高收入邮政编码区域获得的休闲旅行价值高出25%。这些影响可能削弱公园管理者通过低收费实现公平准入的努力。
title: Online Reservation Systems, Buying Frenzies and Equitable Access to Public Lands
title_zh: 在线预订系统、抢购热潮与公共土地公平准入

abstract: Abstract Rural electrification is widely promoted to improve livelihoods, yet its land-use consequences in forest frontiers remain unclear. Using longitudinal household surveys linked to property boundaries and satellite land cover in the Brazilian Amazon, we apply heterogeneity-robust staggered-adoption difference-in-differences. Electrification increases cattle income over the medium term but has no detectable effect on annual property-level deforestation. Income gains appear to reflect herd expansion on existing pasture and a modest refrigerated-milk price premium rather than higher per-animal productivity.
abstract_zh: 农村电气化被广泛推广以改善生计，但其在森林前沿地区的土地利用后果仍不明确。利用与巴西亚马逊地区财产边界及卫星土地覆盖数据相关联的纵向家庭调查，我们采用了异质性稳健的分阶段采用双重差分法。电气化在中期内增加了养牛收入，但对年度财产层面的森林砍伐无显著影响。收入增长似乎源于现有牧场的牛群扩张以及适度的冷藏牛奶价格溢价，而非单头动物生产力的提升。
title: Rural Electrification in the Brazilian Amazon
title_zh: 巴西亚马逊地区的农村电气化

abstract: This paper develops a pilot timber asset account for the United States, demonstrating how a novel discount price method can value timber stocks in Georgia. While valuing merchantable timber is straightforward, an important methodological challenge is valuing trees that are not yet harvestable. Our approach values young stands by discounting their expected harvest price until they reach merchantable size. This method requires standard forest inventory data and market prices currently available in the U.S., making it promising candidate for scaling nationally. For southern yellow pine in Georgia, we estimate timber assets of $5.9 billion, with pre-merchantable timber contributing $257.7 million.
abstract_zh: 本文为美国构建了一个试点性木材资产账户，展示了如何运用一种新颖的折现价格方法对佐治亚州的木材存量进行估值。虽然对可采伐木材进行估值相对直接，但一个重要的方法论挑战在于如何评估尚未达到采伐规模的树木。我们的方法通过对幼龄林分的预期采伐价格进行折现，直至其达到可采伐规模。该方法仅需美国现有标准的森林资源清查数据和市场价格，因此具备在全国范围内推广的潜力。针对佐治亚州的南方黄松，我们估算其木材资产价值为59亿美元，其中未成熟木材贡献了2.577亿美元。
title: Toward a timber asset account for the United States
title_zh: 构建美国木材资产账户

abstract: Abstract Flood risk is increasing in the United States, but how property markets respond to this hazard is unclear. Focusing on Houston, Texas, we analyze changes in flood risk capitalization in property prices after three major Gulf Coast hurricanes. We compare two measures of flood risk–floodplain designations from the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), and a hydrologically-imputed, continuous measure, Height Above the Nearest Drainage (HAND). HAND affects property prices after a storm in intuitive ways, while we observe counterintuitive post-storm price premiums within FEMA floodplains. Plausibly exogenous measures like HAND may be useful tools for characterizing flood risk in economic analyses.
abstract_zh: 摘要 美国洪水风险日益加剧，但房地产市场如何应对这一灾害尚不明确。本文以德克萨斯州休斯顿为研究对象，分析三次重大墨西哥湾飓风后洪水风险资本化对房产价格的影响。我们比较了两种洪水风险衡量指标——联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）划定的洪泛区，以及基于水文模拟的连续指标“最近排水高度”（HAND）。研究发现，HAND在飓风后以直观方式影响房产价格，而FEMA洪泛区内的房产在飓风后却出现反直觉的价格溢价。具有外生性特征的指标（如HAND）或可作为经济分析中刻画洪水风险的有效工具。
title: Who Has the Upper HAND in a Hurricane?
title_zh: 谁在飓风中占据上风？

abstract: Voters in multiparty systems often fail to coordinate on majority-preferred parties. Using constituency-level election data linked to party-ideology measures across 96 countries, we show that in 20–30% of multiparty elections since 1940 the Condorcet winner does not win, and in roughly 10% the winner is the Condorcet loser. Failures are most common under plurality rule and in fragmented, volatile party systems, and systematically disadvantage opposition and culturally liberal parties while benefiting organizationally strong ones. Can information fix this? In four pre-registered experiments around Indian elections (N > 4,000), constituency-level polls shift voting intentions by at most 2 percentage points, a precisely estimated null, despite modest belief updating, though undecided voters become 7 points more likely to support a viable party. A model with expressive motives rationalizes both results: polls refine beliefs but lack the leverage to overcome entrenched attachments, identifying boundary conditions on polls as coordination devices.
abstract_zh: 在多党制中，选民往往难以协调支持多数偏好的政党。通过将96个国家的选区级选举数据与政党意识形态指标相关联，我们发现自1940年以来，20%至30%的多党选举中孔多塞胜者未能获胜，约10%的选举中胜者实为孔多塞败者。此类失败在单一选区制、碎片化且不稳定的政党体系中最为常见，并系统性地不利于反对党及文化自由主义政党，而有利于组织力量强大的政党。信息能否解决这一问题？在围绕印度选举开展的四项预注册实验中（样本量>4000），选区级民调对投票意向的影响至多为2个百分点——这一精确估计的零效应，尽管存在适度的信念更新，但未决选民支持可行政党的概率提升了7个百分点。一个包含表达性动机的模型可同时解释这两项结果：民调虽能修正信念，却缺乏克服根深蒂固依附关系的杠杆作用，从而界定了民调作为协调机制的条件边界。
title: Majority Lost: Global Evidence and Field Experiments on Electoral Miscoordination
title_zh: DP21790 多数派失利：选举协调失灵的全球证据与实地实验

abstract: News aggregators are among the primary gatekeepers of online news, shaping both consumption and production through the algorithms that rank stories and sources. We provide the first large scale estimates of this algorithmic power using the example of Yandex News, Russia’s largest aggregator. Combining archived front pages with 12.3 million published articles and outlet-level traffic data, we estimate that occupying the entire top-5 news block for a day raises an outlet’s traffic by roughly 380,000 visitors. After a 2016 law made aggregators liable for cited content, Yandex halved its references to independent outlets, yet consumers did not penalize the manipulation: its referrals converted readers at the same rate, and its market share did not fall. Removed outlets shifted toward longer articles and stopped optimizing headlines for the algorithm, showing that aggregator algorithms shape not only news consumption but also production.
abstract_zh: 新闻聚合器是在线新闻的主要守门人，通过排序报道和来源的算法，同时塑造新闻消费与生产。我们以俄罗斯最大的聚合器Yandex News为例，首次大规模估算了这种算法的影响力。结合存档首页、1230万篇已发表文章以及媒体层面的流量数据，我们估算出，占据前五名新闻板块一整天可使一家媒体的流量增加约38万访客。2016年一项法律要求聚合器对引用的内容负责后，Yandex将独立媒体的引用量减半，但消费者并未惩罚这种操纵：其引荐的读者转化率保持不变，市场份额也未下降。被移除的媒体转向发布更长的文章，并停止为算法优化标题，这表明聚合器算法不仅塑造新闻消费，也影响新闻生产。
title: Platform Power in News Aggregation
title_zh: DP21789 新闻聚合中的平台权力

title: A Quantitative Analysis of Multidimensional Changes in Unemployment Insurance Policies
title_zh: 失业保险政策多维变化的定量分析

abstract: This paper presents a new dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE)framework based on recursive quantile preferences (quantile certainty equivalent),in which household downside risk attitudes are a model primitive. In this economy,infinitely lived households maximize the discounted value of the stream offuture τ-quantile utilities for τ ∈ (0, 1) with standard consumption and disutility oflabor. The quantile parameter τ captures the households’ downside risk attitude,independent of the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. Representative firmsare price takers, and prices are determined endogenously. We establish centralproperties of the model, including: (i) existence and uniqueness of a fixed pointfor household value functions, (ii) envelope condition, and the quantile Euler equation.We define the quantile recursive competitive equilibrium and establish itsexistence and uniqueness. We also provide an algorithm and numerically computethe quantile DSGE procedure. Lastly, we employ nonlinear impulse responsefunctions and present empirical results for the varying one-time technology shockimpulse response functions for augmented MaCurdy and KPR utility functions.We find significant heterogeneity in downside risk attitudes with the potentialfor countercyclical labor responses for a shallow shock in an otherwise frictionlessenvironment. Rates of dissipation of the shock also vary with the configuration.
title: A DSGE Model of Downside Risk
title_zh: 下行风险的DSGE模型

abstract: In multi-winner elections, the goal is to select a pre-given size committee of members from a given set of candidates. We define the concept of T-power of a majority-group of voters (Total majority-power or Total tyranny-power) as the ability of the group to guarantee, under a given voting rule, that all the committee members belong to its favorite candidates, regardless of the preferences of the other voters. In this case, we say also that such a voting rule is exposed to T-power. This situation can be considered extreme and worrying in democracy. In this paper, we examine the T-power under classes of multi-winner scoring rules. We focus on some common rules, and it turns out that BLOC rule ( k - k -Approval) is totally exposed to T-power, that is, any majority-group of any size has T-power under this rule. On the other hand, CCR, k -Plurality and k -Inverse-Plurality rules are almost notexposed to it, that is, no majority of any size has T-power. These last rules may provide some protection for minority groups in the sense of preventing T-power.
abstract_zh: 在多赢家选举中，目标是从给定候选人集合中选出预先设定规模的委员会成员。我们定义多数选民群体的T-权力（总多数权力或总暴政权力）为：在给定投票规则下，该群体能够确保所有委员会成员均来自其偏好的候选人，而无论其他选民的偏好如何。在此情况下，我们也称该投票规则暴露于T-权力之下。这种情形在民主制度中可被视为极端且令人担忧。本文研究了多赢家计分规则类别下的T-权力。我们聚焦于若干常见规则，发现BLOC规则（k-k-批准制）完全暴露于T-权力，即任何规模的多数群体在此规则下均拥有T-权力。另一方面，CCR、k-复数制与k-逆复数制规则几乎不暴露于T-权力，即任何规模的多数群体均不拥有T-权力。这些规则在防止T-权力意义上可能为少数群体提供一定保护。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The T-power of a majority under multi-winner scoring rules
title_zh: 多数在多胜者计分规则下的T权力

abstract: As populations in rich countries age and fewer youngsters enter the labour force, employers and politicians bemoan labour ‘shortages’. This column turns to historical evidence to highlight why governments should learn to love labour shortages. Between 1792 and 1815, as Britain and France fought each other for global dominance, more than one out of every ten British men ended up in the army or navy, resulting in acute labour shortages and upward pressure on wages. The authors show how this labour scarcity and a skill abundance complemented each other in driving technology diffusion, boosting British productivity in the long run.
abstract_zh: 随着富裕国家人口老龄化及年轻劳动力减少，雇主和政界人士纷纷抱怨劳动力"短缺"。本文通过历史证据揭示政府为何应学会拥抱劳动力短缺。1792年至1815年间，当英法为争夺全球霸权而战时，超过十分之一的英国男性最终服役于陆军或海军，导致严重劳动力短缺并推高工资水平。作者论证了这种劳动力稀缺与技能充裕如何相互促进，推动技术扩散，最终在长期内提升了英国的生产率。
authors: Bruno Caprettini, Alex Trew, Hans-Joachim Voth

title: Technology adoption and labour shortages: Evidence from Britain’s Industrial Revolution
title_zh: 技术采纳与劳动力短缺：来自英国工业革命的证据

abstract: he Voluntary Carbon Market (VCM) rests on the premise that one carbon credit compensates for one tonne of emissions. While a growing body of evidence questions the integrity of many credits, much less is known about whether the ability to offset affects firms’ incentives to reduce their own emissions. Using a buyer-linked dataset covering the near-universe of offset retirements, we exploit the 2023 carbon-market scandals as a quasi-natural experiment. Firms that stop offsetting after the shock reduce their operational (Scope 1) emissions substantially more than firms that continue to purchase offsets. This finding is consistent with moral licensing: access to offsets weakens firms’ incentives to undertake internal abatement. We also document persistent oversupply, opaque intermediation, and sharp price and volume responses to the scandals. Our results identify a demand-side problem in the VCM that is distinct from concerns about credit quality: even when credits represent genuine emissions reductions, the option to offset may slow decarbonization within purchasing firms.
abstract_zh: 自愿碳市场（VCM）建立在“一个碳信用抵消一吨排放”的前提之上。尽管越来越多的证据对许多碳信用的真实性提出质疑，但关于抵消能力是否会影响企业减排动机的研究仍十分有限。利用覆盖近乎全部碳信用注销的买方关联数据集，我们将2023年碳市场丑闻作为准自然实验。研究发现，在冲击发生后停止碳抵消的企业，其运营排放（范围一）的减少幅度显著高于继续购买碳抵消的企业。这一发现与道德许可效应一致：碳抵消的可获得性削弱了企业开展内部减排的动机。我们还发现市场存在持续供应过剩、中介环节不透明，以及丑闻引发的价格与交易量剧烈波动。我们的研究揭示了VCM中一个区别于碳信用质量问题的需求侧困境：即使碳信用代表真实的减排量，抵消选项也可能减缓购买企业的脱碳进程。
title: An Autopsy of the Voluntary Carbon Market
title_zh: DP21788 自愿碳市场剖析
